items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: She had a colored boy around New York by the name of Bill Beaudry. Bill Beaudry made all her arrangements... Bill Beaudry made her arrangements for her act.

ctx.x: Oh, really? I bet you had a lot of pictures.
But this is Bill. This is the guys today. Bill's the drummer. Arnold would play piano. Tom played trombone.
Oh, is Arnold a bass player?
